== Title ==
<span lang="ja">タイ・アドヴァンストｘ１（先行試作機）</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-303o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値１の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">タイ・アドバンストｘ１は動力、装甲、火力の全てが強化されており、帝国宇宙軍のエリート・パイロットに支給される。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' TIE Advanced x1 (prototype).

'''Card text:''' Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' The TIE Advanced x1 has upgraded propulsion, armor, and firepower. It is issued to elite Imperial Navy pilots.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 3
* '''Printed subtype:''' Starfighter
* '''Power:''' 2
* '''Maneuver:''' 2
* '''Hyperspace:''' No hyperdrive
* '''Deploy:''' 2
* '''Forfeit:''' 3

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
